title: Cloud Nurdz – 4500 Puff 0mg Disposable Vape
description:
Cloud Nurdz – 4500 Puff 0mg Disposable Vape
One of the most well-known American brands of e-liquid, Cloud Nurdz’s 4500 Puffs Disposable Vape
is now available in a disposable vaporiser. This single-use vape consistently produces large, flavourful hits.
The ability to recharge the internal battery ensures consistent performance.
Cloud Nurdz 4500 Puff Disposable Pod Vape Specifications:
Nicotine level-contains:
no nicotine (0mg nicotine)
4500 puffs
Battery Capacity: 800mAh
E-liquid Capacity: 12mL
Rechargeable battery
Cloud Nurdz 4500 Puff Disposable Pod Vape Flavours:
Sour Watermelon Strawberry
Blue Raspberry Peach
Apple Watermelon
Watermelon Berry
Mint Nurdz
Iced Blue Raspberry Peach
Iced Apple Watermelon
Iced Watermelon Berry
Iced Sour Watermelon Strawberry
Package Includes
1 x Cloud Nurdz 4500 Puff Disposable Pod Vape in chosen flavour
